messages:
Avery: Quick sync — kicking off cross-cloud activation for the storefront listing (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need owners for: SKU packaging, legal signoff, IAM/terraform access, and publisher assets. Target soft launch: 2023-11-28 (two weeks). Who can take which item?
Sam: I can own product packaging + trial config. I'll prepare bundle options and SKU prefixes. Need SKU spreadsheet from Partnerships.
Marta: I'll collect logos, screenshots, and short hero blurb. Can someone share brand guidelines? @Sam want me to align trial CTA copy with packaging?
Diego: Legal here — EULA + export control + data residency notes. Send me the draft terms & any third-party notices. I'll aim for signoff in 3 business days.
Priya: Eng — we'll validate connectors and IAM roles. Need terraform/publisher creds in a service account. Please share minimal permissions. Ideally we provision a test project/env per cloud.
Avery: Good. I'll own Partnerships side and hand off SKU mapping. I'll upload the initial SKU CSV to the shared folder.
marketplace-bot: :bell: Listing template v2 uploaded: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/templates/listing-v2.md (updated 1699000000)
Sam: Thx. Initial packaging plan: 3 SKUs — dev-lite, dev-standard, enterprise-trial. Propose SKU prefixes: RWD-DEV-L / RWD-DEV-M / RWD-ENT-T. Comments?
Diego: Prefers no 'ENT' in SKU if it implies legal entanglements. Suggest RWD-ADV-T instead.
Marta: Also want hero blurb options. Draft 1: "Low-latency LLM inference, predictable pricing, turnkey cloud deployment." Draft 2: shorter: "Scale inference across clouds." Which one?
Priya: From eng perf POV include expected latency & GPU types in the notes (e.g., A100/RT). We'll need that on the listing.
Avery: Action items (rough):
- Avery: upload SKU CSV + mapping (today)
- Sam: produce packaging doc + trial flow (48h)
- Priya: validate infra + provide example IAM policies (72h)
- Diego: legal draft review (3bd)
- Marta: asset pack + blurb (48h)
Diego: Can we add a checkbox for 'third-party model disclaimers' and 'data handling statement'?
Sam: Yes. I'll add those to the packaging doc.
Priya: IAM snippet for reference:
```
resource "google_service_account" "publisher_sa" {
  account_id = "rwd-pub-sa"
}

# minimal roles: roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, roles/storage.objectViewer
```
Marta: Where should I upload hero assets? Shared drive or publisher portal?
Avery: Shared drive for now: /Shared/marketplace/activations/1701123344
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Compliance requested manifest: upload 'privacy_and_terms.pdf' to the same folder.
Sam: I'll run a quick preflight checklist tomorrow morning. If everything looks green, we can request staging publish to AWS/GCP/Azure.
Diego: Leave a placeholder for legal stamp on the manifest: 'legal_signoff: pending'. I'll update when done.
Priya: One more note: For GCP we need a service account with roles/storage.objectViewer + roles/compute.viewer. For AWS, minimal cross-account role with sts:AssumeRole + AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess. I'll paste a sample if needed.
Marta: Can we schedule a 30-min handoff call tomorrow 10:30 PT? Quick review of packaging + assets + infra.
Avery: 10:30 PT works for me.
Sam: I'm in.
Diego: Works.
Priya: I'll be there.
Avery: Cool — I'll send calendar invite and include the shared drive link + SKU CSV once uploaded. Thanks team :rocket:
